confidence_notes: Food anchors are rough benchmarks from undated or mixed-date Sri Lankan cost-of-living sources and a Colombo bar-markup survey; I found no Sigiriya-specific menu prices. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain, and cocktail and wine_glass are set from the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 2x) because direct drink prices were weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; I did not inspect live booking pages or listings. The FX observation is the 2026-10-16 value from an RBA page snippet that may be a cached copy, so it should be checked against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asia, using Sri Lankan national cost-of-living estimates for restaurant meals, coffee and beer, adjusted for Sigiriya's tourist-village pricing. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small tourist town in the Sri Lankan Cultural Triangle, with peak-season uplift assumed for July.
